title: Fenwick tree range sums
statementMd:
Maintain an array. `['update', i, v]` sets `nums[i] = v`; `['sum', l, r]` returns the sum of `nums[l..r]` inclusive. Return the results of the sum operations.

**Example:** `range_sum_updates([1, 3, 5], [["sum", 0, 2], ["update", 1, 2], ["sum", 0, 2]])` returns `[9, 8]`.
hints: A Fenwick (binary indexed) tree supports both in O(log n).
